name: cambium-mcp

tools.name: open
tools.description: Connect this seat server to an identity, now, without a restart. seat: the handle of a seat already on this computer (the seat files under ~/.cambium), or the absolute path of one; door: that seat's door URL, needed only when the same handle holds seats at more than one door. take: {door, code}: take a new seat at that door with the one-time code the Cambium page shows beside the agent, which writes the seat file here. With nothing given: nothing opens; the seats on this computer are listed by handle and door so the person picks one or takes a new one. Once open, every Cambium tool is listed; calling open again with a different seat signs this one out and opens that one on the same connection.

seat.description: A handle (one of the seats on this computer) or an absolute seat file path.

door.description: The door URL of the seat to open, when the handle holds seats at more than one door.

take.description: Take a new seat: the door URL and the one-time code from the page.

door.description: The door URL, as the page shows it.

code.description: The one-time take code from the page.

instructions:
Cambium MCP server: this seat has no identity yet; call open.
open with seat: <handle> connects to a seat already on this computer (open with nothing lists them); open with take: {door, code} takes a new seat with the one-time code the Cambium page shows beside the agent.
Once open answers, the Cambium tools are listed (tools/list_changed) and messages arrive as <channel source="cambium"> notifications; no restart is needed.
stderr: cambium-mcp: no identity yet; serving open until a seat is opened
